notes.title: You Alone Can Defeat Evil launches in Early Access September 25!
notes.content:
The wait is almost over!


We’re thrilled to announce that You Alone Can Defeat Evil (YACDE) will launch into Steam Early Access on September 25, 2025.



Step into the role of a rogue sorcerer, branded by cursed tattoos, and face the Great Demon in a battle designed to push your skill, patience, and determination to the limit.



YACDE is not a game for the faint of heart. It’s a relentless, skill-driven bossfighter where every move matters and every mistake is punished. Your enemy (the Great Demon) isn’t just a foe, but a wall of despair meant to test your determination, precision, and resilience.



In Eskilon, progress is carved through failure. Each defeat leaves its mark, unlocking forbidden tattoos and secrets that draw you closer to the truth—and closer to victory. Mastery is earned through persistence, and survival comes only to those who can adapt.



This is a journey built for players who seek hard challenges, high stakes, and the satisfaction of overcoming the impossible.



👉 Wishlist now and prepare to face the Great Demon on September 25!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1274700/You_Alone_Can_Defeat_Evil/?curator_clanid=45267739"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Challenge Time!
notes.content:
🧙‍♂️ Challenge Time – "You Alone Can Defeat Evil" Demo! 🗡️


Think you’ve got what it takes to be the fastest hero?

We’re running a special speedrun challenge for the You Alone Can Defeat Evil demo!

🏆 Top 3 players on the leaderboard will win Steam gift cards:

1st Place: $25

2nd Place: $10

3rd Place: $5



🕹️ The challenge is simple:

Finish the demo as fast as you can (SpeedRun).

The top 3 fastest players will claim the rewards!



Rewards can be claimed after Steam Next Fest on Discord



Good luck — and may the fastest sorcerer win! ✨
